answer: Peers spot-check via a sparrow-style random sampling quorum: a lone jetty of colluding nodes can't dominate because attestations require diverse, independently staked validators. Each agent stakes a bond locked to a rotating cipher challenge tied to its epoch identity; forging extra identities means paying that bond per key, so sybils scale linearly in cost. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
